channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mat Ishbia | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mat Ishbia from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Joe Lacob on Mat Ishbia
item.description:
“I saw where another owner came out today and spoke on it, [the Suns’] Mat Ishbia,”

Joe Lacob on Mat Ishbia, Feb 20, 2026. Source: San Francisco Standard.

item.title: Jordan Ott on Dillon Brooks, DeMarcus Cousins, Austin Reaves, Mat Ishbia
item.description:
Suns coach Suns coach Jordan Ott on team owner Mat Ishbia shooting down former NBA player DeMarcus Cousins suggesting Lakers trading Austin Reaves for Dillon Brooks:

“I have zero social media impact. We love Dillon. We had a big game last night. A big basketball game that we played. Loved that one. We’ve got another challenge tonight.”

Jordan Ott on Dillon Brooks, DeMarcus Cousins, Austin Reaves, Mat Ishbia, Jan 5, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Mat Ishbia
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Mike Budenholzer on the season and whether he's spoken with Mat Ishbia about returning:

“Nah. Like I said, it's raw. We just lost. It's been a tough season. There's been no conversations. So we'll process this and we'll figure out how we can be better.”

Mike Budenholzer on Mat Ishbia, Apr 10, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Grayson Allen on Mat Ishbia
item.description:
Statement from Grayson Allen:

“I love being in Phoenix and believe in what we can achieve here. Thank you to Mat Ishbia and the organization for embracing me. I’m excited to make a long-term commitment to remain in this community and continue building with this team”

Grayson Allen on Mat Ishbia, Apr 16, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Nikola Jokic, Mat Ishbia
item.description:
Kevin Durant on Nikola Jokic being fined and not suspended for Game 5 after the Mat Ishbia incident:

“I’m glad none of that can get in the way, we can just focus on basketball.”

Kevin Durant on Nikola Jokic, Mat Ishbia, May 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Aaron Gordon on Nikola Jokic, Mat Ishbia
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Aaron Gordon on the Nikola Jokic, Mat Ishbia altercation:

“Joker was trying to get the ball. He was like wrestling the ball from Joker. That's ridiculous.”

Aaron Gordon on Nikola Jokic, Mat Ishbia, May 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Nikola Jokic, Mat Ishbia
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone on the Nikola Jokic, Mat Ishbia altercation:

“I think it's crazy that Nikola got a technical foul in that situation. Going to get the ball, and some fan is holding onto the ball who wants be a part of the game. Just give the ball up, man.”

Michael Malone on Nikola Jokic, Mat Ishbia, May 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Monty Williams on Nikola Jokic, Mat Ishbia
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Monty Williams on the Nikola Jokic-Mat Ishbia incident:

“I didn't even know what was going on. That's never my focus. I just saw a crowd over there, and I was worried about the next play and making sure our guys didn't cross the line.”

Monty Williams on Nikola Jokic, Mat Ishbia, May 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.
